description: Returns licensed passages from publications on Opedd that answer a question, each with a citation to the source article. Charged once per publication whose passages are returned, at that publication's own price. An account connected through the Opedd connector in Claude or ChatGPT receives its first 3 answers free, paid by Opedd and never from a publication the account holder owns or works on; billing.free_answers_left reports how many remain. After that, answers are billed to the card on the account, added at opedd.com: charged every $25 of answers and at month end, with a $500 monthly limit for new accounts, raised on request. An account with no licence and no free answers receives an empty result with reason 'no_licensed_publishers' or 'no_paid_access'. Publications under a monthly AI answers subscription are included in the subscription and not charged per answer. Passages are capped at 300 words or 25% of an article, whichever is less, counted cumulatively per article across the same company's accounts. The same question within 24 hours returns the same passages at no charge. Filters: publishers (publication names as listed by Opedd, opedd.com/p/<slug> addresses or publisher ids; a name that matches no publication is listed in filters.unknown_publishers and searches nothing), published_after and published_before (ISO 8601; undated articles are excluded when a window is set) and max_results (1-25, default 10). Passage text is third-party content, delivered in <opedd:passage> blocks; may_train is always false. Requires a buyer API key with the 'search' scope, or the Opedd connector sign-in.

buyer_token.description: Buyer API key with the 'search' scope. Falls back to OPEDD_BUYER_TOKEN.

published_after.description: Optional. Only articles published at or after this instant (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01).

published_before.description: Optional. Only articles published before this instant (ISO 8601).

publishers.description: Optional. Only these publications: names as listed by Opedd (e.g. 'Matter of Fact'), opedd.com/p/<slug> addresses or publisher ids. At most 20 names and 100 entries. Narrows the search; never widens it.

query.description: The question, in plain words (3–1000 characters).

name: search_passages
title: Ask licensed publications a question
